name: Housekiya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood jewelry shop: a ring-resizing service notice, a first day helping wrap a necklace as a gift, a birthstone necklace price list with a point-card bonus, a free earring-care service notice, a resizing-service comparison, a column on learning to ask customers why they chose a ring, a trainee lesson on basic pearl care, an explainer on why a repair consultation corner started, an engraving-service application guide, a column on how more repair requests changed the shop's day, a busy-season reception rule, a column on the meaning of a jewelry shop's craft, and a one-year cooperation report with a wholesale gem supplier. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
